translations.english: Exceptionally splendid one, (Ravana) embodied with glowing body entered the royal court constructed by Vishwakarma, with pillars of gold and silver. Inside of the court was pure like crystal and carpeted with shining golden silk. It was very beautiful and ever shining and guarded by six hundred devils.
translations.hindi: का सध्यभाग स्फटिक पत्थर का बना हुआ था ओर उसके ऊपर सनहले रुपहले काप का फश EEN हुआ था। शरीर को सजाय हुप ओर छः सौ पिशाचो द्वारा राक्तत वह महातेजस्वी रावण वश्व कसा क बनाए सभापवन म गया
